sourceTraceBoundary: This source trace maps each generated manual WCAG review packet provenance row to the sourceArtifacts key used by the owner worksheet. It does not perform manual accessibility review, read owner-held reviewer notes, screenshots, recordings, assistive-technology transcripts, issue details, evaluation-tool output, sample archives, artifact hash source maps, private user data, or upgrade launch readiness.
evidenceBoundary: This packet is an owner-review worksheet only. Raw reviewer notes, screenshots, recordings, assistive-technology transcripts, reviewer identity, reviewer profile URLs, meeting/calendar links, issue tracker details, evaluation-tool output, sample archives, artifact hash source maps, and private user data must remain owner-held outside tracked files. The packet does not make placeholder hashes count as proof.
hasherInputBoundary: When hashing proof artifacts, use ordinary owner-held files outside git or under an ignored local proof path. The hasher rejects symbolic links, hard-linked files, tracked files, staged files, and non-ignored repository files; copy proof material to a single-link owner-held file before hashing.

relevantOwnerActions.ownerAction: Generate the manual WCAG review packet, complete the owner-held WCAG-EM review from the route/checkpoint matrix, document product scope, sample rationale, sample-selection method, technologies relied upon, complete processes, support-baseline combinations, reviewer type/conflict boundary, review-record archive attestations, and ownerEvidenceArchive policy metadata, hash local WCAG review proof files, replace placeholder hashes in the ignored local evidence file, and keep raw reviewer notes/screenshots/AT transcripts/tool output/sample archives/hash source maps outside git.
relevantOwnerActions.ownerPrepCommand: npm run generate:manual-wcag-review-packet && npm run hash:owner-evidence-artifacts -- <local WCAG review proof files>

checkpointReviewPlan.label: WCAG-EM scope and sampling
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Confirm the target standard, product scope, route sample, sample-selection method, technologies relied upon, complete-process coverage, browser/assistive-technology support baseline, evaluator role, independence/conflict boundary, owner-held WCAG-EM report-tool export, review-record archive, and reporting boundary before any conformance language is considered.
ownerHeldArtifacts: WCAG-EM Report Tool JSON or HTML export retained owner-held
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Keyboard focus and focus-not-obscured review
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Tab through each route and interactive state at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths, including sticky navigation, dialogs, long forms, report downloads, and status panels.
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Pointer target size review
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Measure compact links, icon buttons, table actions, badges used as controls, mobile CTA clusters, and form controls for target size or spacing exceptions.
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Form errors, labels, instructions, and redundant entry
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Exercise lead capture, coach sample, resume analyzer, workforce CSV, counselor forms, and evidence download flows with missing, invalid, and repeated values.
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Accessible authentication and account/payment access
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Review sign-in, payment, account, and synthetic-user flows for cognitive-function-test barriers and accessible alternatives before institutional pilots.
ownerHeldArtifacts: payment/account screenshots with private data redacted
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Screen-reader name, role, value, relationships, and keyboard semantics
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Use assistive technologies to review menus, dialogs, generated reports, evidence cards, CSV/HTML download controls, dynamic status messages, and route navigation.
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Contrast, reflow, non-text contrast, and text spacing
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Run contrast and text-spacing/reflow checks on commercial cards, badges, alerts, charts, proof packets, downloadable HTML, mobile layouts, and any dark-theme surfaces.
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

checkpointReviewPlan.label: Downloadable HTML/CSV/proof artifact accessibility
checkpointReviewPlan.reviewerGoal: Open downloaded trust packets, risk CSVs, sample reports, proof-pack exports, and pilot-validation artifacts, then review names, headings, tables, keyboard access, assistive-technology behavior, and non-web document/software applicability boundaries.
checkpointReviewPlan.failureBoundary: If unresolved issues remain, keep this checkpoint failed or blocked and do not mark the manual WCAG evidence gate complete.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: WCAG-EM scope and route sample
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Evidence uses targetStandard=WCAG 2.2 A/AA, methodology=WCAG-EM, includes all 9 required commercial routes, describes the sample-selection method and technologies relied upon, and covers mobile/tablet/desktop plus browser and assistive-technology matrices.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Scope metadata is necessary but does not prove accessibility until every checkpoint is manually reviewed and accepted.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Complete processes and accessibility support baseline
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Evidence includes all 5 required complete processes and at least 2 explicit browser/assistive-technology support combinations with keyboard input covered.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Support-baseline metadata defines reviewed combinations only; it does not prove unreviewed operating systems, browsers, assistive technologies, or future UI states.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Evaluation specifics and review-record archive
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Evidence includes reviewRecordArchive with all required attestations true: samplesArchivedOwnerHeld, evaluationToolsRecorded, wcagEmReportToolExportOwnerHeld, browserAssistiveTechnologyVersionsRecorded, navigationPathsRecorded, issueLogOwnerHeld, rawEvidenceSecurityReviewed, reEvaluationRequiredAfterMaterialChange.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Archive metadata confirms review records were retained owner-side only; it does not expose the records or independently validate reviewer findings.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Owner evidence archive policy
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Evidence includes ownerEvidenceArchive with all required policy fields true: rawReviewerNotesOwnerHeldOutsideGit, screenshotsRecordingsOwnerHeldOutsideGit, assistiveTechnologyTranscriptsOwnerHeldOutsideGit, reviewerIdentityOwnerHeldOutsideGit, issueDetailsOwnerHeldOutsideGit, evaluationToolOutputOwnerHeldOutsideGit, sampleArchivesOwnerHeldOutsideGit, artifactHashSourceMapOwnerHeld, reReviewRequiredAfterMaterialChange.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: OwnerEvidenceArchive metadata is a storage and re-review policy only; it does not expose raw artifacts or prove WCAG conformance.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Official W3C/WAI reference basis
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Evidence includes all 7 required W3C/WAI references with exact URLs and non-future accessedAt dates not later than asOf.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Reference metadata proves the review basis only; it does not prove the app satisfies those standards.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Reviewer attestation and redaction boundary
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Reviewer identity is represented only by a non-placeholder sha256 hash, review type and independence/conflict boundary are disclosed, expertise is attested, manual and assistive-technology reviews are complete, raw notes stay owner-held, and no WCAG conformance or procurement-approval claim is made.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Reviewer attestation supports the owner evidence gate but does not create legal, procurement, or warranty language.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Required checkpoint coverage
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: All 8 required checkpoints are present once, use accepted statuses only, include every required route, include checkpoint-specific standard refs, and provide the required evidenceSummary fields.
ownerHeldEvidence: WCAG-EM Report Tool JSON or HTML export retained owner-held
payment/account screenshots with private data redacted
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Checkpoint coverage is redacted metadata; unresolved issues, missing routes, duplicate checkpoints, or missing evidenceSummary fields keep the gate incomplete.

verifierAcceptanceChecklist.label: Proof hashes and issue closeout
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.acceptedWhen: Every accepted checkpoint has at least one non-placeholder sha256 proof hash, unresolvedIssueCount=0, a non-negative remediatedIssueCount, and explicit does-not-prove boundaries.
ownerHeldEvidence: ordinary local proof files hashed with npm run hash:owner-evidence-artifacts; When hashing proof artifacts, use ordinary owner-held files outside git or under an ignored local proof path. The hasher rejects symbolic links, hard-linked files, tracked files, staged files, and non-ignored repository files; copy proof material to a single-link owner-held file before hashing.
verifierAcceptanceChecklist.boundary: Hashes prove only that owner-held artifacts were represented in the metadata; they do not expose or independently validate the raw artifacts.
